title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset their password by navigating to Settings and then selecting the Security tab. On the Security page, click the 'Change Password' button. You will be prompted to enter your current password followed by your new password twice for confirmation. Passwords must be at least 8 characters long and include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character. If you have forgotten your current password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. A password reset link will be sent to your registered email address. This link expires after 30 minutes. If you do not receive the email, check your spam folder or contact support.

title: Refund Policy
content: Our refund policy allows users to request a full refund within 14 days of purchase if they are not satisfied with the service. To initiate a refund, go to Billing in your account settings and click 'Request Refund'. Refunds are processed within 7 business days after approval and are credited back to the original payment method. Subscription renewals are non-refundable once the billing cycle has started. One-time purchases such as add-ons and credits are also non-refundable after activation. For enterprise plans, refund terms are governed by the signed service agreement. If you believe you were charged in error, contact our billing support team within 48 hours of the transaction.

title: Subscription Plans
content: We offer three subscription tiers: Free, Pro, and Enterprise. The Free plan includes up to 5 projects, 1GB of storage, and community support. The Pro plan costs $19 per month and includes unlimited projects, 50GB of storage, priority email support, and access to advanced analytics. The Enterprise plan is custom-priced and includes everything in Pro plus dedicated account management, SSO integration, 99.9% SLA uptime guarantee, custom storage limits, and 24/7 phone support. All paid plans renew automatically at the end of each billing cycle. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan at any time from the Billing section in your account settings. Downgrading takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

title: Account Deletion
content: Users can permanently delete their account by going to Settings and selecting the Account tab, then clicking 'Delete Account' at the bottom of the page. You will be asked to confirm your decision by entering your password and typing the word DELETE. Account deletion is irreversible. All your data, including projects, files, and history, will be permanently removed within 30 days of the deletion request. Active subscriptions are automatically cancelled upon account deletion, but no refunds are issued for the remaining period. If you have an active Enterprise contract, please contact your account manager before deleting your account. You can download your data before deletion using the Data Export feature under Settings.

title: Customer Support
content: Customer support is available through multiple channels depending on your plan. Free plan users can access community forums and submit tickets through the Help Center. Pro plan users receive priority email support with a response time of within 4 business hours. Enterprise plan users have access to 24/7 phone support and a dedicated account manager. To contact support, click the Help icon in the bottom-right corner of the dashboard or visit support.example.com. When submitting a ticket, include your account email, a description of the issue, and any relevant screenshots or error messages. Our support team is available Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM UTC for all plans, with extended hours for Enterprise.

title: Two-Factor Authentication
content: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. You can enable 2FA by going to Settings, then Security, and clicking 'Enable Two-Factor Authentication'. We support two methods: authenticator apps such as Google Authenticator and Authy, and SMS verification. To use an authenticator app, scan the QR code displayed on screen and enter the 6-digit code generated by the app. For SMS, enter your phone number and verify with the code sent to you. Once 2FA is enabled, you will be asked for a verification code each time you log in from a new device. If you lose access to your 2FA device, use one of the backup codes provided during setup. Store these backup codes in a safe place. Disabling 2FA requires confirming your identity with your current 2FA method.

title: Data Privacy and GDPR
content: We are committed to protecting your data and complying with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We collect only the data necessary to provide our service, including your name, email address, and usage data. Your data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. You have the right to access, correct, export, and delete your personal data at any time from the Privacy section in your account settings. We retain your data for as long as your account is active. Upon account deletion, data is purged within 30 days. For GDPR data requests or to appoint a Data Protection Officer contact, email privacy@example.com. A full copy of our Privacy Policy is available at example.com/privacy.

title: API Access and Integration
content: Pro and Enterprise users can access our REST API to integrate with third-party tools and build custom workflows. To generate an API key, navigate to Settings and select the API tab, then click 'Create New API Key'. Each key can be given a name and scoped to specific permissions such as read-only or full access. API keys should be kept secret and never shared publicly. If a key is compromised, revoke it immediately from the API settings page. Our API follows RESTful conventions and returns responses in JSON format. Rate limits apply: Free plan users get 100 requests per hour, Pro users get 5,000 requests per hour, and Enterprise users have custom limits. Full API documentation including endpoints, request formats, authentication headers, and code examples is available at docs.example.com/api.

title: File Storage and Uploads
content: Each account comes with a storage quota depending on the subscription plan: 1GB for Free, 50GB for Pro, and custom limits for Enterprise. You can upload files through the dashboard by dragging and dropping into a project or clicking the Upload button. Supported file types include PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, JPG, MP4, and ZIP archives. Individual file uploads are limited to 500MB. To manage storage, go to Settings and then Storage to view your current usage and delete files you no longer need. Files deleted from the interface are moved to the Trash and permanently removed after 30 days unless you empty the Trash manually. Storage usage is updated every hour. If you exceed your storage limit, uploads will be blocked until you free up space or upgrade your plan.

title: Billing and Invoices
content: All billing is managed from the Billing section in your account settings. You can view your current plan, next renewal date, payment method, and download past invoices. We accept major credit cards including Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and PayPal. For Enterprise customers, we also support bank transfers and purchase orders. Invoices are automatically generated on each billing cycle and sent to the billing email address associated with your account. To update your payment method, click 'Edit Payment Method' in the Billing section and enter your new card details. Failed payments trigger an email notification and a 7-day grace period during which you can update your billing information before your account is suspended. VAT or tax may be added depending on your country of residence.
